framework_lessons: Distinguish supply-shock hedges from recession hedges.
Consolidate money-like claims before interpreting liquidity.
assessment: Near-term liquidity and asset appreciation worked, and the gold breakout and EPD distribution calls were supported. The energy case needs a distinction between portfolio insurance and a forecast that drilling constraints will cap production: EIA evidence shows substantial productivity gains. Money aggregates require consolidation rather than treating near-money instruments as interchangeable. Binance enforcement verifies compliance oversight, not solvency. The 3-5 year energy horizon and the full 2024-2026 gold interval remain open.
verification_limitations: Current snapshot is not an authenticated publication-date vintage.
Image labels were inventoried; chart images were not inspected.
No portfolio or equity total returns are inferred from business results.
